visualPreservationChecklist.purpose: The attractive Web visuals are NOT redrawn, replaced or re-authored by Map. These are the exact primary-source locations Gameplay must retain while adding the LR02 static layer.

pixelTrees.location: art.ts buildSources/drawTree helpers + render.ts drawSource() (lines ~238-259), A.src.oak/pine/snowpine/palm/willow, deterministic per-source variants

animatedShoreline.location: wave = Math.sin(time/520 + tx*0.7 + ty*0.3); glint rgba(235,248,255,0.85); sparkle rgba(220,240,255,0.7)

sohIdentity.location: OUT='#140c14' pixel outline, VT323/Pixelify Sans local fonts, original pixel art only

visualLanguagePreserved.pixelTreesAndTerrainVariation: Unmodified real Web screenshots (class 1) are preserved byte-for-byte as the quality baseline; the Web pixel trees are NOT re-authored by Map. Class-2 analytical previews keep the authored 12-code biome raster, hard-edged 1px transitions and authored roads. No new procedural grass.
visualLanguagePreserved.oceanAndLargeWaveMotifs: Retained sparse large 3-cell wave motifs drawn ONLY where the next three cells are sea; no flat lake treated as ocean.
visualLanguagePreserved.shoreGlints: Static previews keep the deterministic shore fringe; the Web runtime animated glint (render.ts draw() rgba(235,248,255,0.85) + rgba(220,240,255,0.7) sparkles) stays in Gameplay and is NOT simulated here.
visualLanguagePreserved.naturalTransitions: PRIO-based neighbour fringe from ACTUAL neighbouring biome codes, not random noise.
visualLanguagePreserved.nativePixelReadability: All before/after files are exactly 640x360, integer px, shape-rendering=crispEdges, image-rendering=pixelated, no antialias/resample.
visualLanguagePreserved.sohIdentity: Web T.PWALL / T.FLOOR palette, door jamb colour from T.PWALL[4], existing Web shadow/depth convention.

layerOrder.name: lr02_static_architecture
layerOrder.note: NEW. Clipped solid spans + real static openings. Proposed placement: after footprints, before ground structures so roofs/entities sort correctly.

integrationInstructions: Read portal_geometry.v1.json at its pinned revisionDigest; do not read a preview PNG as geometry.
For each staticSolid draw a pixel-snapped hard-edged wall segment at integer Web pixels using the existing T.PWALL ramp; blocksMovement/blocksSight come from the package, not from the picture.
Do NOT draw a stroke inside any staticOpening interval. Openings are static holes; Gameplay owns doorState/lockedState/powerRequirement/destruction.
Keep imageSmoothingEnabled=false; never scale the layer with smoothing; keep 640x360 native readability.
Eligibility cellIndices are NOT a visual layer. Do not tint cells, draw grids, arrows, labels or any decorative debug overlay.
Roof/canopy polygons remain UNRESOLVED; do not substitute a room polygon or landmark for a roof.

layers.usage: Composite AFTER the Web terrain chunks + animated water/shore glints and BEFORE the ground-structure/roof/entity passes. Draw at integer pixels with imageSmoothingEnabled=false; never resample. Openings are ABSENCE of stroke; Gameplay draws dynamic door sprites (A.st.poi_door / poi_door_open) at the opening centre and owns lock/power/destruction state.
